Data Preprocessing 
```{r echo= F}

## create baseline variables and transform variables as needed

input_RM <- input_RM %>%
  group_by(PatientId) %>%
  mutate(
    # find baseline if labelled "Baseline", otherwise use earliest visit
    baseline_MOCA_total = {
      # pick explicit baseline rows first
      b <- moca_total[visit_number == 1]
      if (length(b) == 0) {
        # if no explicit "Baseline", pick value from earliest visit row
        b <- moca_total[which.min(as.numeric(factor(visit_number, levels = unique(visit_number))))]
      }
      # take first baseline/earliest value and repeat for all group rows
      rep(b[1], n())
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

input_RM <- input_RM %>%
  group_by(PatientId) %>%
  mutate(
    # find baseline if labelled "Baseline", otherwise use earliest visit
    baseline_updrs_iii = {
      # pick explicit baseline rows first
      b <- updrs_iii[visit_number == 1]
      if (length(b) == 0) {
        # if no explicit "Baseline", pick value from earliest visit row
        b <- updrs_iii[which.min(as.numeric(factor(visit_number, levels = unique(visit_number))))]
      }
      # take first baseline/earliest value and repeat for all group rows
      rep(b[1], n())
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

input_RM$visit_number <- factor(input_RM$visit_number)
input_RM$gender <- factor(input_RM$gender)
input_RM$PatientId <- factor(input_RM$PatientId)

```

## Filter by Patient age at Onset (baseline stats)
```{r echo=TRUE}

#create baseline only patient file
working_file = subset(input_RM, input_RM$visit_number == 1)

hist(working_file$age_enrolment, main = "Age_enrolment")
hist(working_file$age_onset, main = "Age at Onset")
hist(working_file$age_at_visit, main = "Age at Visit")
hist(working_file$age_diag, main = "Age at Diagnosis")

# what to use as filter
dim(subset(working_file, working_file$age_at_visit < 50))
dim(subset(input_RM, input_RM$age_diag < 50))
dim(subset(input_RM, input_RM$age_enrolment < 50)) # same as 29 that are less than 50 at first visit

input_RM <- subset(input_RM, input_RM$age_enrolment > 50)
dim(input_RM)


    
```
Data for three visits used. Updated n = 742

## Data Testing
Cross sectional probe example (MOCA total ~ seq.12800.5)
```{r echo= T}
m1 <- summary(lm(as.formula(paste("moca_total ~", "seq.12800.5", "+ visit_number + 
+                                age_at_visit + gender + ledd_total" )), data = input_RM))

m2 <- summary(lm(as.formula(paste("moca_total ~", "seq.12800.5", "+ visit_number + 
+                                age_at_visit + gender + ledd_total + baseline_MOCA_total")) , data = input_RM))


tab_model(m1, m2, show.se = TRUE, digits = 3, digits.p = 5)
```
\vspace{1cm}

## Cross sectional analysis
Total MOCA Cross sectional analysis - full probe set
```{r echo= T}

selected_proteins = epic.pro.list$`SomaScan SeqId`
working_file = subset(input_RM, input_RM$visit_number == 1)
dim(working_file)

regression_MOCA = matrix(nrow = length(selected_proteins), ncol = 5) # output matrix 
for (iP in 1:length(selected_proteins)){
  
  out <- glm(formula = as.formula( paste( c( paste("moca_total" , " ~ ", selected_proteins[iP]), c("gender", "age_at_visit", "ledd_total")),     collapse = " + " ) ),

             data = working_file,  family = "gaussian")
  regression_MOCA[iP,3] =  summary(out)$coefficients[2,1] # beta
  regression_MOCA [iP,4] = summary(out)$coefficients[2,4] # pvalue
  regression_MOCA [iP,5] = summary(out)$coefficients[2,2] # st.error
}

regression_MOCA [,1] = epic.pro.list$Protein
regression_MOCA [,2] = epic.pro.list$`SomaScan SeqId`
regression_MOCA  <- cbind.data.frame(regression_MOCA , p.adjust(regression_MOCA [,4], method = "fdr"))

colnames(regression_MOCA ) = c("Protein", "seqID", "beta_MOCA", "pvalue", "std.err", "p.adj")
regression_MOCA <- regression_MOCA %>%
  arrange(pvalue)

protein.out.sig <- subset(regression_MOCA , regression_MOCA [,4] < 0.05)

knitr::kable(regression_MOCA, format="markdown", digits = 3)
```

## Longitudinal analysis using Mixed Linear Models
Total MOCA Longitudinal analysis - full probe set
```{r echo= T}

selected_proteins = epic.pro.list$`SomaScan SeqId`
working_file = subset(input_RM, input_RM$visit_number == 1)

MLM_MOCA = matrix(nrow = length(selected_proteins), ncol = 5) # output matrix 
for (iP in 1:length(selected_proteins)){
  
  out <- (lmer(as.formula(paste("moca_total ~", selected_proteins[iP], "+ visit_number + 
                               age_at_visit + gender + ledd_total + 
                               (1|PatientId)")), data = input_RM)) 
  MLM_MOCA[iP,3] =  summary(out)$coefficients[2,1] # beta
  MLM_MOCA [iP,4] = summary(out)$coefficients[2,5] # pvalue
  MLM_MOCA [iP,5] = summary(out)$coefficients[2,2] # std.err
}

MLM_MOCA [,1] = epic.pro.list$Protein
MLM_MOCA [,2] = epic.pro.list$`SomaScan SeqId`
#colnames(MLM_MOCA ) = c("beta_MOCA", "pvalue", "Protein", "seqID")
MLM_MOCA  <- cbind.data.frame(MLM_MOCA , p.adjust(MLM_MOCA [,4], method = "fdr"))



colnames(MLM_MOCA ) = c("Protein", "seqID", "beta_MOCA", "pvalue", "std.err", "p.adj")
MLM_MOCA <- MLM_MOCA %>%
  arrange(pvalue)

protein.out.sig <- subset(MLM_MOCA , MLM_MOCA [,6] < 0.05)

knitr::kable(protein.out.sig, format="markdown")
```

## Sensitivity Testing
TPPP2 Testing - longitudinal probes (MOCA Total ~ seq.12800.5)
```{r echo=FALSE}

  # adds p-values

model1 <- lmer(as.formula(paste("moca_total ~", "seq.12800.5", "+ visit_number + 
+                                age_at_visit + gender + ledd_total +
+                                (1|PatientId)")), data = input_RM)

model2 <- lmer(as.formula(paste("moca_total ~", "seq.12800.5", "+ visit_number + 
+                               age_at_visit + gender + ledd_total + baseline_MOCA_total +
+                                (1|PatientId)")), data = input_RM)

model3 <- lmer(as.formula(paste("moca_total ~", "seq.12800.5", "+ visit_number + 
+                               age_at_visit + gender + ledd_total + rbd_total +
+                                (1|PatientId)")), data = input_RM)

model4 <- lmer(as.formula(paste("moca_total ~", "seq.12800.5", "+ visit_number + 
+                               age_at_visit + gender + ledd_total + updrs_iii_13 +
+                                (1|PatientId)")), data = input_RM)

# Put models in a list
models <- list(
  M1 = model1,
  M2 = model2,
  M3 = model3,
  M4 = model4
)

# Function to extract results
extract_model <- function(model, name) {
  tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    select(term, estimate, std.error, p.value) %>%
    rename(
      Term = term,
      !!paste0("Estimate (", name, ")") := estimate,
      !!paste0("SE (", name, ")") := std.error,
      !!paste0("p (", name, ")") := p.value
    )
}

# Extract and merge all tables
final_tbl <- imap(models, extract_model) %>%
  reduce(full_join, by = "Term")

# Markdown table
kable(
  final_tbl,
  format = "markdown",
  digits = c(
    0,  # Term column
    2, 2, 5,   # M1: Estimate, SE, p
    2, 2, 5,   # M2
    2, 2, 5,   # M3
    2, 2, 5   # M4
  )
)
```
